Line or code reference:
```
if ! gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${row_issue}/comments" -f body="${answer_body}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ...
    continue
fi
outcome="answered"
...
security_pass_mark_followup_merge_checked "${row_issue}" || \
    echo "::warning::Could not record the ai:blocked check for advisory follow-up #${row_issue}..."
```

Problem: The POST succeeds and the bookkeeping write fails, leaving the row unchecked so the next merged-state tick can POST another `/answer`.
Why it fails at runtime: A persistently broken state-file write permits duplicate comments until plan.yml moves the issue off ai:blocked, violating the documented at-most-once contract.
